messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "should be taken with food, with the evening meal"
set: ["should be taken with food, with the evening meal", "some forms are taken only once daily with the evening meal", "titrated to 1800 mg orally once daily with the evening meal", "may be taken with or without food, but take it the same way each time", "oral granules should be taken 30 minutes before a meal", "next dose should be taken the following day", "may be taken with or without food", "can be taken with or without food", "take with a meal or immediately after a meal", "usually taken once a day in the evening", "some forms may be taken with or without food", "oral granules should be mixed with applesauce or apple juice when taken by mouth", "duration should be consistent with individual patient treatment goals", "tablets and capsules can be taken with or without food", "take with food or just after a meal", "dose should be adjusted in patients with reduced kidney function"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
